dataset: Sandia SAT tracker faults (second real rig)
reason: Sandia SAT CSVs not found in backenddata/datasets/sandia_sat.
why_it_matters: The only rig in reach whose physical configuration is documented, and the only chance at a labelled false-positive rate on hardware that is not Lazzaretti.
registered_prediction: 6 x Canadian Solar CS3U-355PB-AG in series gives Vmp near 238 V. The un-normalised cascade calls below 245 V short circuit and below 260 V degradation, both being Lazzaretti's operating point hard-coded. So this rig's HEALTHY voltage sits inside the fault band, and the fixed-reference run is expected to misclassify a large share of known-healthy rows while the self-normalised run is not. Registered before the data was in hand.
